about: Norfolk County is a single-tier municipality on Lake Erie in southwestern Ontario, covering former towns and townships rather than one urban core. Simcoe is the county seat; Port Dover, Delhi, Waterford, and Port Rowan sit among farms that once specialized in tobacco and now grow a wider mix of crops. Long Point and a long sand shoreline define the lake edge. About 67,000 people live in Norfolk County.
seoSummary: Lake Erie municipality of farms and shore towns, with Simcoe as the seat and Port Dover on the beach.
